situation: A hospital group whose accounts payable team routes supplier invoices to budget holders by email.
complication: Many invoices miss payment terms, the group pays late fees, and reminders helped only a little.
key_question: Where does invoice approval time go, and what would lift approval within terms?

titles.situation: Many invoices are approved after payment terms.
titles.options: Two ways to speed up invoice approval.
titles.recommendation: Set approval rules with escalation to cut waiting.
titles.roadmap: Change the rules first, then measure against the target.
titles.kpis: Two measures show approval is faster.
titles.risks: The main risk is approvers rubber-stamping invoices.

options.name: Rules and escalation
options.description: Route each invoice by cost centre, set approval limits, and escalate invoices left waiting too long.

options.name: Purchase orders first
options.description: Require a purchase order for all spend except agreed exemptions.

actions: Map cost centres to approvers and draft approval limits and escalation rules.
Give the finance director the plan within the four weeks.
